description: FREE, give-to-get. Check a price you were quoted (or plan to quote) for an AI product against the vendor's own published list price and the category. Returns discount off list, position in the category and data freshness. The quote is added to the private benchmark (never published individually), which is the price of the answer.

list_usd_month.description: Optional: the list price you were shown, if different from the public page.

quoted_usd_month.description: Quoted monthly price in USD, per seat for per-seat.

share_to_benchmark.description: Must be true. The quote joins the private benchmark; it is never published individually.

name: pricing_quote_check
